regions.today: Mainly dry and breezy this evening with bright or sunny spells, these at their best in the south of the province with cloudier periods further north, all in a moderate to fresh and gusty westerly wind.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with variable amounts of cloud and clear spells. Continuing breezy with moderate to fresh westerly winds but the winds will ease in the south overnight. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 11 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Saturday will be a dry day with a mix of cloud and warm spells of hazy sunshine. Highest temperatures of 16 to 20 degrees in light to moderate west to northwest winds.
